It models contribution -> AI-reader notes -> human review -> attachment targets -> before/after synthesis snapshots -> revision event, and the live healthcare ledger now mirrors this public-record change.

room_record.title: Healthcare
room_record.description: A Civic Logos room for healthcare administration, access, cost, governance, and implementation questions.
room_record.scope_note: Fixture is limited to Administrative Simplification and AI-Assisted Triage.

claim_record.title: Administrative simplification and AI-assisted triage could reduce cost and access friction
claim_record.claim_text: Standardized administrative flows and guarded AI-assisted intake may reduce healthcare cost and access friction if savings, safety thresholds, and implementation burdens are evidenced.

synthesis_snapshots.synthesis_text: The United States can reduce healthcare cost and access friction by standardizing administrative flows, using AI-assisted intake and triage for low-risk routing, and reinvesting verified savings into primary and preventive care.
unresolved_items: Administrative-cost baselines are not yet attached.
Transition costs are not yet bounded.
Human escalation thresholds for AI-assisted triage remain unresolved.

synthesis_snapshots.synthesis_text: Administrative simplification and AI-assisted triage remain plausible healthcare reform levers, but the card should not treat net savings, access gains, or clinician-time recovery as established until administrative-cost baselines, transition costs, savings-capture rules, human-escalation thresholds, and provider-time impacts are attached to evidence.
unresolved_items: Administrative-cost baselines must be attached to evidence.
Transition costs must be estimated before net savings are asserted.
Savings-capture rules must identify who receives benefit.
Human-escalation thresholds for AI-assisted triage need review.

human_review_decision.public_record_note: This is a founder-maintainer revision, not an outside public submission. It narrows the visible synthesis after AI-assisted review and human incorporation.
human_review_decision.decision_reason: Incorporated because the revision makes the topic more falsifiable and prevents overclaiming savings, access gains, or clinician-time recovery before evidence is attached.

revision_event.reason_for_change: The prior public synthesis was too likely to read as an established savings/access claim. The new synthesis keeps the reform levers alive while making evidence burdens and implementation risks explicit.
revision_event.reviewer_note: This revision narrows the card to avoid overclaiming. It keeps the topic alive while making the evidence burden and implementation risk more explicit.

appeal_records.appeal_reason: The revision correctly keeps transition costs unresolved, but a later reviewer may decide whether transition-cost burden should be promoted into a more prominent open question before any stronger savings claim appears.
